title: Hypoxia-activated scleraxis a mediates epicardial progenitor differentiation into a unique cardiac perivascular cell type.
snippet: The epicardium provides progenitor cells and paracrine signals essential for heart development and regeneration, yet the mechanisms regulating epicardial cell fate remain poorly understood. title: Crosstalk between S-nitrosylation and glycation defines a metabolic vulnerability in liver and renal cancers.

title: The DLX/Notch axis is necessary for spatiotemporal regulation of neural cell fate.
